column7: 2026-11-06: On release/10.x, CI publishes straight from this branch whenever the version in package.json changes. Any code fix landing here must bump the patch version in package.json in the same change, otherwise it never ships (rule stated by the user).

2026-11-06: On branch next, never edit the version in package.json by hand. The release job derives it from the changesets and fails if anyone bumps it manually (user's rule, stated 2026-11-06). This differs from release/10.x, where a patch bump is required.
